definition.partner: P(x)=reverse_n(x), unless x is a palindrome, then complement(x)
definition.ring: sorted representatives x<P(x), followed by their partners in reverse representative order, then swap the two central entries
definition.address: physical position loc[x] in that ring; address bits are indexed from least significant bit 0
definition.readiness: for input x, address bit b is ready after k arrivals iff it is constant among all words agreeing with x on the k observed bit positions
definition.score: exact average of event index across all 2^n input words and all n output address bits
definition.scope: Exhaustive over every input word for each listed reader and over all structured-family orders; not exhaustive over all n! bit-arrival orders at widths 13-16.
